name: privileged_shell_exec
title: Run Admin Command
description: Runs an elevated root/administrator command on a supported HHC client via the cryptographic privileged helper daemon. client_id and command are mandatory. Highest-risk operation: grants root/administrator execution. Explicit Admin authorization applies and user confirmation is recommended before execution.

client_id.description: Target HHC client. Absolute routing handle, independent of any connection.

command.description: Shell command line executed with root/Administrator privileges.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock bound in seconds for the command.
